voiceover: You fix a tiny bug and push straight to main. No branch, no pull request, no review. It's only one line, what could break? Then the build goes red and every message starts with your name. A branch costs nothing. It lets someone catch your mistake before it's live, and you can throw it away if it's wrong. Main is the version people depend on. Treat it like it matters. Send this to whoever pushes straight to main.
